out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at prep area handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. Person in charge provided soap.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at restroom handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. Person in charge provided paper towels.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: ice cream scoops in dipper well with no running water
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Person in charge turned on water at dipper well.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical bleach and quaternary ammonia sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH, QUATERNARY AMMONIA, test kit before follow-up in 10 days.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located next to the 3 compartment sink is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. Observed hand sink blocked by table.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC relocated table to unblock hand sinks. Please ensure all hand sinks are unblocked and accessible for employees to wash hands at all times.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed no hand soap at hand sink near chest freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC provided soap at hand sink. Please ensure continuous compliance by ensuring soap is available at all hand sinks in facility at all times.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw egg stored above ready to eat juices and cut leafy greens in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC relocated raw shell eggs to bottom shelf in walk in cooler. EHS provided document regarding proper storage of raw animal foods to PIC.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the 3 compartment sink with a concentration of 0 PPM total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. EHS instructed PIC on proper concentration of quaternary ammonium sanitizer. Additional sanitizer added to basin and when tested, observed sanitizer concentration at 200 PPM.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the 3 compartment sink being used to fill and rinse sanitizer buckets.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC removed sanitizer bucket from sink and will only use sink for hand washing.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw egg stored above cut and cleaned celery in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC placed raw shell egg below all ready to eat items.

out_items.name: Food additives; approved and properly used

violations.title: Approved Additives
violations.observation: Food offered for service or sale contains the following unapproved food additives or additives at unapproved levels: supplemental bee pollen, supplemental spirulina, supplemental multivitamin.
violations.corrective_action: Food may not contain unapproved food additives or additives that exceed amounts specified in 21 CFR 170-180 relating to food additives, generally recognized as safe or prior sanctioned substances that exceed amounts specified in 21 CFR 181-186, substances that exceed amounts specified in 9 CFR Subpart C Section 424.21(b) Food ingredients and sources of radiation, or pesticide residues that exceed provisions specified in 40 CFR 180 Tolerances for pesticides chemicals in food, and exceptions. PIC will discontinue use of unapproved additives and has removed them from establishment.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CFM arrived during inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the dish sink being used to store chemical containers.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC removed containers from hand sink.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PIC ordered thermometer during inspection. Compliance will be revisited at next routine inspection.
